note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; sources are named beside each guide. Five guides are marked unconfirmed where PowerPyx reports the exact trigger is not yet known at launch.

trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it — the roadmap in this guide is the route to it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, all single-player with no online trophies. Keep cheats off for the whole run: PowerPyx reports that turning on a cheat disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the opening — there is no way to skip past it, and no special requirement to watch for.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing the story and it pops at the chapter turn. Unmissable, like every chapter trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. Pure story progress — play the missions in order and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Keep playing the story; nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission (gold). PowerPyx lists it as automatic and story-related, unlocking after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Keep a manual save before the finale — there is no mission replay, so a save at the end of each chapter is cheap insurance.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion (gold — the hardest trophy, per PowerPyx). The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: for example scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish any 70 of 80 challenges and any 100 optional missions. Nothing for 100% is missable — all of it can be done in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (300 are needed for the 100% checklist). There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them freely, and PowerPyx calls under-the-bridges the quickest. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and marker.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; most are introduced by the story or marked when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on everything else.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a guide to all 12 range locations; the gold medals are not too difficult. Work through them range by range and track them in Progress > Activities.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Winning once per location is enough — you do not need to win every race at a location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so any 20 distinct wins count. Race wins also count toward the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will send a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at his own challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck, found at arcade machines around the world. Finish all the levels of any one of them once — you do not need to beat every in-game challenge, just reach the end. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline (Lucia only). It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. Five quests in total: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked KR in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests (a metal detector helps dig them from the ocean floor) and bring them back to his shop. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3; calling Brian as Jason speeds it up. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain stranger questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Strands confirmed to count by PowerPyx: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being found. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy list itself tracks how many you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); he marks some on the map and more appear as you deliver. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, and deliver them in good condition for more money. The cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and this can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City, which you destroy in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE potentially missable trophy (PowerPyx): the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can only be done in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is still unconfirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, but do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only). After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot leaves animals pristine and pays more, but is not required. There are 15 Target Decks in total and all are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida (PowerPyx); find the cards and finish any 3 full sets. Cards are a collectible type, so sweep them up while you explore for the map and WAiNK trophies.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold the WAiNK scan on landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around the world — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass. Scanning is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 categories of 10). 70 of 80 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges, and leave it for late: many complete naturally while you work on other trophies, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Only possible after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner, cause carnage up to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). Easiest escapes per PowerPyx: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. After Coffee Break, call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, and a 4th shop may be needed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad) and scan vehicles — 557 vehicles exist at launch, so just stand on a busy road and scan the traffic. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. 200 scanned vehicles are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically. Check Progress > Vehicles for your totals.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming: it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drink or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 at a gang operation — criminals count, while soldiers, police and civilians reportedly do not. Focus has 4 levels, raised through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by level 4 this is much easier, and it often pops naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (silver). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons; finish his earlier Payday Loans quests first). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles. 8 large bank jobs exist and all are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way; a bank can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is…, counts: tailing the armored truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. An earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; you unlock Yasmani as a fence in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the map across its 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every fogged region until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx links a fast unfogging route and plane choice. Do it while you travel for other trophies and it finishes itself.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 39 illegal gang operations exist (yellow map icons when you go near them); one per gang is enough for the trophy, but all 39 are needed for 100%. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — it shows how many of their operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact trigger as not yet known, so this guide does not guess a location. The description points to ordering a cocktail at a bar overlooking Ocean Beach — try the beachfront bars once the area is open, and check back as guides confirm it. Treat any single unconfirmed step with suspicion until two guides agree.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as not yet known. The description suggests driving a car through a showroom's frontage — try it at a dealership with a sturdy car once you are in free-roam, and expect guides to pin it down soon after launch. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a step.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation). Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically, or later when the robbery icon respawns — you do not need all 3 in one visit. The valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, and killing the enemies is not necessary.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train together (call your partner; while one trains, the other progresses too). Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); home workouts work after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile (PSN tracks the count to 500 — click the trophy in the list to see your count). Turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see a demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes), Hardened, Violent and Psycho, up to Irredeemable — which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight, so avoid going that far. It accumulates passively through robberies and fights; if it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Keep an eye on the Payday Loans storefronts as guides confirm the method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: PowerPyx believes it is tied to a UFO questline, but the trigger is not yet confirmed. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than inventing a step — check back once the UFO content is mapped by guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: PowerPyx believes it involves knocking enemies down with a melee attack while driving a motorcycle, but the exact trigger is not yet confirmed. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. Try melee attacks from a moving motorcycle once you are comfortable, and expect confirmation soon after launch.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults (Chapter 4) give up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, since they are the most expensive. Shop counts per PowerPyx: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (total $160,000; the 4 story garages do not count). Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone and you buy through it. Fund it with robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You need enough garage parking first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds spots. Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register; at first he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
